posts.cooked:
I have just bought Sentinels of the Multiverse and all expansions plus the Villian oversized cards. I have 2 villian cards that differ from the oversized cards, they are.

The Dreamer. Two differencies. 

The normal villian card. on the reverse it states in paragrath 4 that, At the end of the villian turn, The Dreamer deals each non-villian target H minus 2 psychic damage, then, play the top H minus 2 cards of the villian deck.

The oversized villian card, on the reverse it states in paragraph 4 that, At the end of the villian turn, The Dreamer deals each hero target H minus 1 psychic damage, then, play the top H minus 2 cards of the villian deck.

non-villian target against hero target and H minus 2 psychic damage againsst H minus 1 psychic damage

Do you know which are correct?

 

The Matriarch front and back.

The normal villian card, on the front of the card there are 2 sentances more than on the villian oversized card, they are. Whenever a fowl card enters play, The Matriarch regains H minus 2 HP. The other is Whenever a fowl card is played from the villian deck, play the top card of the villian deck. On the reverse there is one paragraph missing, the nornal villian card says Whenever a fowl card is played from the villian deck, play the top card of the villian deck, this is not on the reverse of the oversized villian card.

Do you know if they should be on both cards or not?

Alan

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: The normal card is the correct one in both cases. In Dreamer's case, it's just a simple typo. However in Matriarch's case, the original printing of Rook City had the "whenever this card is played, play the next card" on the Fowl Cards, but they decided to alter it in future printings, because cards like Hair Trigger Reflexes could stop the chaining of cards. They have not had the need to reprint over sized cards, however once they do reprint them there will be an "update" pack that will be sold that will contain the corrected cards.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
On her front side, when you destroy a Fowl, Lilian will deal damage to the highest-hp hero unless they destroy one of their cards - so that person can choose which of the two effects happens to them, basically. But that's every time a Fowl is destroyed, so if someone's doing an AE that's gonna take out a whole load of them, you're either gonna lose all your stuff or take a lot of damage (unless you have soak in which case yay :D). More so if Muninn is out (and even more if Huginn's there too).

On her flip side, Lilian regains hp every time a Fowl enters play…so if she chains a whole bunch of them then yes, she will heal up a lot (unless you're in the Time Cataclysm with Oppressive Smog out - I think that's the only effect in the game currently which reduces healing).

I think a few typos and stuff may have been corrected in the new version (I have the old one, like you), like the Checmical Explosion and stuff. The main change to Lilian's deck, as far as I'm aware, was that the "When a Fowl card enters play, play the top card of the villain deck" text was moved from the Fowl cards to Lilian's, because otherwise you could prevent them chaining via Hairtrigger Reflexes (Expatriette).
